ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Naive: Despite all his power, Hourman is uncertain how to truly be a hero and live up to his heritage. Though his fellow heroes and his friends help him as best they can, Hourman sometimes turns to the wrong people for advice. Amazo: Since stealing part of Hourman’s time powers, the android Amazo is behind many of Hourman’s problems.
